==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
Before bed, I learned that my city has the most moon trees in the world. Moon trees are trees planted from seeds that traveled on space missions to the moon. I believe that is what influenced the following dream.

The dream takes place in a futuristic city. The city is divided into factions, who compete in their pursuit to study the Undergrowth. The Undergrowth is an alien, underground, giant serpent made of soil.

I am very protective of the moon trees, as I believe them to be the source of the Undergrowth. Other factions wish to use the trees to somehow control the Undergrowth. I believe that the Undergrowth shouldn't be used as a weapon and I fight to keep it safe.
-------
I have a power watch. With my watch, I can shapeshift and I can create decoys of myself. My decoys resemble dried, red, humanoid, eyeless, husks that each are wearing fake watches.

I am running through a field. Using my shapeshifting power I turn my feet into wheels, so that I can run faster. There is something chasing me that is annihilating my decoys.

I know that whatever is after me, is after my watch. I know it has very sharp claws. But I don't think it ever made itself fully visible.
